chapters.title: NEW SUPPLY ZONE
chapters.text: Three bearish bars in a row on at least average volume: the tool draws a supply zone 26,530.25–26,539.00 on the last bullish candle before the move. Action edge 26,530.25.

chapters.title: SUPPLY DEFENDED
chapters.text: Price trades into the supply zone at 26,530.25 and closes back below it, short of the far edge 26,539.00: a filled diamond, and the zone's conviction rises. Aggressive buying was 76% of the volume inside the zone on this bar.

chapters.title: SUPPLY DEFENDED 2×
chapters.text: The second return to the supply zone: price closes back below it, short of the far edge 26,539.00, and another filled diamond prints. Aggressive buying was 61% of the volume inside the zone on this bar.
